import sys, random; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from warmcheck import brute_warmup
from certcheck import validate_plan
import gen, para, algo, topo
rng=random.Random(202)
bad=0; n=0; safe=0
for it in range(600):
    K=rng.randint(1,4)
    prof=gen.gen_profile(rng,K,consistent=True)
    prof['jitter_ps']=[0]*K
    # make the measurements exact so H = 0
    for m in prof['measurements']:
        m[2]=m[3]
    cal=para.Calibration(prof)
    if not cal.feasible: continue
    fab=gen.gen_fabric(rng,K=K)
    fab['drift_ppb']=[0]*fab['n']
    fab['heat']=[]
    fab['reconfig_ns']=0
    plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fab)
    ok,msg=validate_plan(prof,fab,plan)
    if not ok:
        print('INVALID', msg); bad+=1; break
    if plan['guard_ns'] is not None:
        safe+=1
        F=topo.Fabric(fab,cal)
        bw = brute_warmup(F, plan['guard_ns'], plan['pred'], plan['bounds_as'], plan['age_rounds'])
        if bw != plan['warmup_cycle']:
            print('WARMUP MISMATCH brute=%s plan=%s'%(bw,plan['warmup_cycle'])); bad+=1; break
    n+=1
    a=algo.audit(prof,fab,plan)
    if a!={'valid':True}: print('AUDIT FAIL'); bad+=1; break
print('checked',n,'safe',safe,'bad',bad)
EOF
